material_and_resistance.uncertainty_statement: the 25-38 mm structural depth and 10-25 mm electromagnetic envelope are distinct and are never silently equated

mesh.segmentation_justification: 48 segments retain wall-following resolution while keeping every poloidal length at least five times the through-thickness width
mesh.segmentation_rule: the nominal structural wall band is assigned to 48 nearest equal-arclength exterior generators

provenance.excluded_repair_component_rule: retain the largest validity-repaired component as physical wall; bank but do not mesh the tiny self-intersection residue

thincurr.statement: 1.32e-6 ohm.m resistivity and a 10-25 mm effective electromagnetic thickness envelope

vessel_design.statement: Inconel 625 sandwich wall with 25-38 mm structural depth

scope.basis_interpretation: 48 geometric wall loops require eigenmode reduction; individual loop currents are not independently recoverable

self_inductance.eigenmode_reduction_caveat: operator conditioning and off-diagonal coupling prohibit treating individual loop currents as independently recoverable; any dynamic model must reduce to identifiable eigenmodes
self_inductance.kernel: exact polygon section-averaged coupling, quadrature order 2
self_inductance.quantity: section-averaged total poloidal flux per ampere
